build_minitaur_simulation: build a pybullet simulation of a Minitaur quadruped robot with configurable motor control and sensor noise
create_minitaur_instance: create a Minitaur instance with a pybullet client, URDF root path, and optional PD control or torque control enabled
test_apply_action: test the Minitaur ApplyAction method by sending eight motor angle commands and stepping the simulation
refactor_motor_gains: refactor the Minitaur SetMotorGains method to tune proportional and derivative gains for all eight motors
summarize_map_to_minus_pi_to_pi: summarize the MapToMinusPiToPi function that normalizes a list of angles into the range negative pi to pi
